interface.description: The network interface to capture on. 'any' selects the first non-loopback interface.

capture_filter.description: The capture filter expression (pcap filter syntax). Leave empty to disable.

display_filter.description: The display filter expression (Wireshark filter syntax). Leave empty to disable.

output_format.description: The output format for decoded packets. Options include: text, json, fields, ek, pdml, etc.

output_fields.description: List of field names to extract when using -T fields. Example: ['frame.number', 'ip.src']

output_file.description: The output file path for raw packet data. Leave empty to output to stdout.

read_file.description: The input capture file to read. Leave empty to perform a live capture.

statistics.description: List of statistics collection arguments. Example: ['io,phs', 'endpoints,ip']

quiet.description: If true, use -q to suppress continuous packet counts and info messages.

promiscuous.description: If false, use -p to disable promiscuous mode on the interface.

snapshot_length.description: The snapshot length in bytes. 0 means capture the entire packet.
